acceptance_criteria.description: ContextVM sbom/generate and sbom/import handlers enqueue orchestration and return an accepted acknowledgment containing idempotencyKey, run_id, status=accepted, status_d_tag, and observable kinds instead of returning SBOMRunResult completion payloads.
A managed background runner performs SBOM Generate/Import off the request path using channel-driven work delivery, with no polling loops, sleeps, or timeout-based completion detection.

Existing idempotency semantics are preserved: the idempotency key deterministically maps to the sbom:run:<sanitized-key> 30315 d-tag and the orchestrator remains the side-effect/idempotency authority.

Worker-driven orchestration still handles relay OK acceptance, CLOSED before EOSE, and AUTH challenges deterministically and surfaces failures through worker result/status behavior while clients observe terminal truth through 30078/30004.
Docs and PSTF record the HITL Option A asynchronous-ack decision and instruct clients to subscribe to status/reference/availability observables for completion.
